meta.title: San Clemente Market, July 2026: Expected Market Time Falls to 70 Days | Adam Boehrer, Pacific Sotheby's
meta.headline: A home that earns its keep.
meta.lede: San Clemente is clearing inventory faster than anywhere else on this stretch of coast, and four in ten listings have still had to cut their price. Both are true at once. Plus the honest answer to whether you can ever buy here, and the Beach Trail reopening timeline.
meta.description: San Clemente's expected market time fell to 70 days from 98 a year ago, 40% of active listings have taken a price cut, and the June median sale price hit $1.89M. Plus how an owner-occupied home that earns income gets a first purchase across the line in South Orange County. By Adam Boehrer, Pacific Sotheby's International Realty.
